Name: Venue Audio
Author: NoctusDev
Punchline: Broadcast your PC audio and listen together, inside FFXIV.
Description: Broadcast a PC audio output or mixer, optionally add your microphone, and listen together inside FFXIV. Guests join with a six-character venue code, or just by walking into an announced venue. Audio is encrypted before entering the relay. Open using the plugin settings button or /venueaudio.
